answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 37500 Country: India Title: Is it right to make niyah in Urdu before salah or not Question: Is it right to make niyah in Urdu before salah or not? Answer ID: 37500 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 620/426/D=1433) Niyah means to make intention in heart. In order to express the intention of heart, it is alright to say it verbally though in Urdu, rather it is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
